# Session Overview

This session explores Quarto's advanced theming and branding capabilities, covering Bootstrap 5 integration, brand.yml systems, progressive customisation, and extension development for organisational standards.

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, participants will be able to:

- Implement professional themes using Bootstrap 5 foundations
- Create consistent branding across multiple output formats
- Apply progressive customisation from YAML to SCSS
- Develop custom extensions for organisational reuse
- Troubleshoot theming issues and conflicts
- Build maintainable style systems
